title: The Stranger wakes
description: Nori and Poppy cart the Stranger out of the crater and hide him near the camp. He cannot speak their tongue, but he gathers fireflies into a pattern of stars he seems to be looking for.

title: Tunnels beneath Hordern
description: In the ruins Arondir finds a tunnel dug under a house and follows it alone into the dark, where something seizes him.

title: An Orc in the house
description: An Orc breaks through the floor of Bronwyn's home. She and Theo kill it together, and its head finally convinces the villagers that they must leave.

title: The villagers flee to the watchtower
description: The people of Tirharad climb to Ostirith, the tower the Elves have just abandoned.

title: Celebrimbor's great design
description: Gil-galad sends Elrond to Eregion to help Celebrimbor, greatest of the Elven-smiths, who wants to build a forge mightier than any before — and needs it finished by spring.

title: At the doors of Khazad-dûm
description: Elrond seeks out his old friend Prince Durin for help. Turned away at the gate, he invokes a rock-breaking contest, loses it, and wins back Durin's friendship anyway over dinner with Durin's wife Disa.

title: The king's chest
description: King Durin III distrusts the Elves' sudden interest. Together father and son open a chest holding something that shines.

title: Adrift on the Sundering Seas
description: Swimming for home, Galadriel is pulled onto a raft of shipwrecked Men. A sea-worm smashes it; only she and a guarded Southlander named Halbrand come through the storm, until a ship finds them.
